description: Chibi RPG world boss pixel art sprite facing the viewer, Phong Long the ancient majestic wind dragon: authentic traditional Chinese eastern long dragon, absolutely NO wings, extremely long serpentine snake-like scaled body coiling in an S-curve, deer-like branching antlers, long flowing whiskers from the snout, flowing mane and a spiky fin crest running along its spine, four short legs each with sharp eagle-like claws, flame-like tufts of fur at the elbows, tail ending in a flowing tuft, pale jade-green scales with white belly plates, flowing white cloud-like mane and beard, holding a glowing wind pearl, sky-blue eyes, coiling through stylized swirling auspicious clouds
style_usage: Copy ONLY the drawing style: chibi RPG boss look, crisp black pixel outline, shading and detail level. Do NOT copy the colors or the shape of the reference.
